selection: Publish complete screened family, discovery history, and negative results; select target only after feasibility. A bound derived uniformly from the fixed region remains conditional for adaptively selected targets. No held-out performance or novelty claim follows.
primary_success: Unmeasured target or operational resource; full-class bound; nonempty joint set; physical GST-only and RB-only witnesses crossing the same bound/interval; separation exceeding verified numerical error
stopping: Concentrate on a feasible target after auditing at least three. If no primary certificate, report the strongest verified partial result and exact remaining step. Failed local searches or loose outer relaxations are not impossibility results.
permissions: Public source research and computational analysis only; no new acquisition, author contact, or transfer of unrelated calibration
